title: Concept: SQL statement executed through sqlite3_exec in c — review required
description: In c, sqlite3_exec receives a statement string. The API offers no parameter binding, so any dynamic value has to be interpolated by the caller, and C string handling gives no escaping for SQL. A single quote in a value is enough to terminate the literal and continue with attacker syntax.
applicability: c programs that embed SQLite directly.
risk: Query manipulation and data disclosure; HIGH severity.
